comment: Supply-chain-finance programme health at each month-end from Apr-2024 (SCF invoice history start, or the launch month if later) to Sep-2026, as a record_type union (D13). Programme rows (record_key PROGRAMME): programme limit, financed outstanding (invoices drawn and not yet due), utilisation with the 85% / 40% bands and the supplier counts (register, invoicing in 12 months, onboarded, active in 3 months). Supplier rows (record_key = supplier id): one per supplier of the programme's register with its country, spend segment, onboarded / active state, its financed outstanding and the month's flows (invoices approved, drawdowns, financed amount, discount income, USD-days for the yield). Programme amounts sit on Programme rows only and supplier amounts / flows on Supplier rows only, so no measure double counts; the utilisation band repeats on Supplier rows as an attribute. POINT-IN-TIME columns (limit, outstanding, utilisation, supplier counts / states) - take one month-end, never sum across months; the *_in_month columns are monthly flows. The limit is the current programme limit (no limit history), so historical utilisation is measured against today's limit. Grain: one row per SCF programme per month-end per record (the programme itself, or one of its suppliers).
